title: [Shopify] Add GraphQL type to request telemetry
summary: Shopify request telemetry now includes a GraphQL Type custom dimension that captures the query type name for typed requests while preserving privacy by not exposing query contents or variables.
key_points: New GraphQL Type dimension added to telemetry event 0000K8W
Typed requests emit the enum value name; untyped requests emit empty value
Dimension value persists through HTTP and GraphQL retry paths
Enables grouping telemetry by query type without exposing sensitive data
Change is additive with no impact on existing request behavior
